items.note: Apartment 4B named in subject and body.
States heater stopped working on October 2.
'I called you on October 3... haven't heard back since' covers phone report and no response.
Says overnight temperatures are in the 40s; °F not written out but clear in context.
Requests repair 'within 48 hours of this email.'
Cites Section 12 of the lease requiring the landlord to provide heat.
Courteous and offers access and schedule flexibility, while setting a clear deadline and asking for written confirmation.
